experiments.scope: Reduced-width w=14 distinguished-point walk on the 795-operation multiplicative-coin equivalent step function for r=55 partial rounds (N=2^14=16384, K=23, VB=142, WG=119, MCAP=64, Delta=512, S=207, G=128, GPOS=255), returning canonical 64-byte Orchard input pairs (nk, rho) per organizer trial without multi-seed retry.
experiments.hypothesis: Supporting reduced-width evidence for H1: on the BBLP 2-round affine input line with multiplicative coin rho0 in F_p^* and shifted origin W(x) = (rho0*x - d0) mod p, the 795-operation step function truncated to the low w=14 digest bits exhibits empirical single-trial collision recovery rate consistent with the Lemma 3 random-mapping model (reference rate about 0.432 for a uniform random function at these parameters, sigma_256 about 0.031) and produces organizer-verified 14-bit Orchard Poseidon digest collisions.

experiments.scope: Instruction-by-instruction execution of the compiled H2 register-machine program (19,017 instructions, 346 registers, 337 constants, K=22, VB=142, WG=119) at reduced width w=10 (N=2^10=1024, MCAP=32, Delta=64, S=69, G=48, GPOS=95) across all 256 organizer trials, cross-checked against the reference Python search and worst-case operation ledger.
experiments.hypothesis: Direct mechanical verification of H2: the compiled register-machine instruction listing (including online rho0-constant scaling in setup, 22-unrolled 795-op step blocks, 142-bit value and 119-bit gap bit-packing in table_mem, single-segment DP recovery, and 5th-root message reconstruction) produces identical exit statuses and canonical Orchard message pairs to the reference algorithm on every trial while strictly obeying the closed-form worst-case operation bound.
